map.💡 机器人焊接时间约为人工 40%；投资回收期 <3 年为推荐，<2 年为强烈推: 💡 Robot welding time is about 40% of manual time; a payback under 3 years is recommended, under 2 years is strongly recommended.

map.估算机器人年工作小时数，检查产能与班次安排是否匹配。: Estimate the robot's annual working hours and check whether capacity matches the shift schedule.
map.年焊缝总长(m) = 年产量 × 单件焊缝长度；人工年工时(h) = 年产量 ×: Annual total weld length (m) = annual output × weld length per piece; manual annual hours (h) = annual output × manual seconds per piece ÷ 3600; manual annual cost = manual hours × hourly wage. Robot time per piece is estimated at 40% of manual time, so robot annual hours = annual output × robot seconds per piece ÷ 3600; annual running cost = robot annual hours × hourly wage × 0.6 + equipment investment (10k CNY) × 0.02 × 10000 (maintenance taken as 2% of investment per year). Annual saving = manual annual cost − robot annual running cost; payback (years) = equipment investment (CNY) ÷ annual saving. Assessment: under 2 years strongly recommended, 2~3 years recommended, 3~5 years feasible, 5 years or more needs caution.
map.年产 20000 件、单件焊缝 2 m、单件人工 600 s、时薪 60 元、机: With 20,000 pieces a year, 2 m weld per piece, 600 s manual per piece, CNY 60 per hour and CNY 300,000 robot investment: manual hours = 20000×600/3600 ≈ 3333 h, manual cost ≈ 200,000 CNY; robot time 240 s per piece → annual hours ≈ 1333 h, running cost = 1333×60×0.6 + 30×0.02×10000 = 48,000+6,000 = 54,000 CNY; annual saving ≈ 146,000 CNY, payback ≈ 300,000/146,000 ≈ 2.1 years, rated as recommended. If annual output is only 5,000 pieces, the saving drops to about 25,700 CNY and the payback stretches to about 11.7 years, which calls for caution.
map.机器人时间按人工 40% 合理吗？: Is 40% of manual time reasonable for the robot?
map.机器人可连续起弧、无需清渣与换条的停顿，通常比人工快 2~3 倍，40% 是常用: The robot can strike continuously without pauses for slag removal or wire changes, so it is typically 2~3 times faster than manual work, and 40% is a common rough estimate. The actual figure depends on weld complexity, positioner coordination and programming quality, and should be calibrated by test welding measurements.
map.回收期短就一定要上机器人吗？: Does a short payback mean you must install a robot?
map.还要看产品批量稳定性与焊缝一致性：多品种小批量时编程与夹具切换成本会显著拉长实际: You also need stable product batches and consistent weld seams: with many varieties in small batches the programming and fixture changeover cost can noticeably stretch the real payback. Repetitive welds with large volume are the scenarios that suit automation best.
map.焊接自动化评估工具，输入年产量、单件焊缝长度、人工焊接时间与时薪、机器人投资额，: The welding automation assessment tool takes annual output, weld length per piece, manual welding time and hourly wage, and robot investment, then computes the annual total weld length, manual and robot annual costs, annual saving and the payback period to assess automation feasibility.
